verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents outbound webhooks that notify external systems when organization events occur ('Outbound webhooks let Gumloop notify your systems when something happens in your organization'), plus inbound webhook triggers for firing agents. This directly satisfies subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of outbound webhook event types and payload schema, and details on subscription management (e.g., selecting specific event types).
